--- select_lookup_join.sql
SELECT * FROM A LOOKUP JOIN B ON A.id = B.id

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },
    },
    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.Join{
        Left: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 14,
            NameEnd: 15,
            Name:    "A",
          },
        },
        Op:     "INNER",
        Method: "LOOKUP",
        Right:  &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 28,
            NameEnd: 29,
            Name:    "B",
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.On{
          On:   30,
          Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
            Op:   "=",
            Left: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 33,
                  NameEnd: 34,
                  Name:    "A",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 35,
                  NameEnd: 37,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
            Right: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 40,
                  NameEnd: 41,
                  Name:    "B",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 42,
                  NameEnd: 44,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT * FROM A INNER LOOKUP JOIN B ON A.id = B.id
